system.description: Celegians rely on transplastseel life-support chambers to survive away from their homeworld. These chambers are filled with cyanogen gas and held aloft by the Celegian's natural levitation. A Celegian Life-Support Chamber possesses a Damage Reduction of 10. A Celegian encased in a Celegian Life-Support Chamber receives a +5 Equipment bonus to their Fortitude Defense, as well as increasing their Fly Speed by +2 squares.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Jedi Academy Training Manual
